Experience the Vibrancy of Bengali Culture at Rishi Panda Live Concert & PBA Durga pujo 2026
Mark your calendars for the 11th of October, 2026, as the Rishi Panda Live Concert & PBA Durga Pujo 2026 in NJ is set to make waves. Hosted by the Princeton Bengali Association (princetonbengalees), this anticipated event will be a marvelous blend of music, spirituality, food, and drink. Immerse yourself in the multilingual performances, witness the vibrancy of Bengali and Hindi cultural traditions, and enjoy a live concert that is sure to leave you spellbound.
Unveiling the Talent of Rishi Panda
At the heart of this event is the acclaimed independent artist, Rishi Panda. From his humble beginnings as a young music enthusiast, Rishi has grown into a popular YouTuber and singer. His partnership with JMR Music has given birth to a plethora of captivating original and cover songs. Known for his soul-stirring performances, Rishi Panda will undoubtedly enchant the audience at this concert.
Discover the Charm of Community Middle School
The event will take place at the well-known Community Middle School, located at 95 Grovers Mill Rd, in the picturesque city of Plainsboro, NJ, United States. The venue is known for its safety and easy accessibility, enhancing the overall experience for attendees. Additionally, the area boasts numerous Indian restaurants for those looking to indulge in authentic Indian cuisine after the event. Parking facilities will also be available at the venue, ensuring convenience for all attendees.
Choose Your Perfect Ticket
Various ticket options are available to cater to your needs. For adults over 12 years, non-veg and veg options are priced at $65.00. For kids aged between 5 and 12 years, comprehensive tickets are available at $55.00. For those who wish to attend only the Rishi Panda show, tickets for adults are priced at $50.00, and for kids, at $45.00. Children below 5 years can enjoy the event at no cost. Secure your spot today to experience an unforgettable celebration of Bengali culture and music.
